example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খুব হাত ছোট, বন্ধুদের জন্য কিছু খরচ করতেই চায় না।
হাত ছোট হলে দানশীলতা আসে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is very small-handed and doesn't want to spend anything on his friends.
If one has small hands, generosity doesn't come easily.
note: This idiom metaphorically refers to someone who is unwilling to give or spend, as if their hands are too small to hold or release much.
